notes.automation_signal_t0037: application_name is anonymized to opaque hashes in this corpus; the automation_scores heuristic (bot/api/scheduler literal match) never fires, so T0037 does not appear in tags and automation-based triage is inert on this data. This is a corpus limitation, not a null result for automation in the campaign.
notes.graph_scale: co-activity pair frames stayed small (coreposts: 163 rows over 165 accounts; duplicate_pairs: 11146 rows over 787 accounts) out of 1,011,052 total rows and 2536 unique accounts, so the coordination graph and community detection ran in seconds with no need to raise min_weight or otherwise cut corners.

account_ids_withheld: Per the Indiana dataset's CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 license, per-account identifiers and cluster memberships are not republished. Only aggregate metrics and cluster sizes are reported here.
